counterfactual.interpretation: The only variable is surface wording. Two faithfulness-preserving normalizations account for the sub-threshold score: resolving the first-person pronoun "I" to the named actor "Jordan" (which also shifts the copula "am" to "is"), and using "seeking" for "asking". Resolving "her" to "Priya" is score-neutral because the golden token set contains both tokens. Reverting the actor resolution alone is sufficient to cross the 0.45 threshold.

ranking.rationale: Only candidate with a same-family golden object at span overlap 1.0 that is already matched. The evaluator’s own granularity_split tier is the designed destination and is blocked by exactly one threshold. Single-variable wording counterfactual isolates the defect with alignment held constant and exactly one finding entry changing.

ranking.not_selected_because: Its span [58,200) is covered by no golden claim at all, so span overlap against every golden claim is 0.0 and granularity_split is structurally unreachable regardless of wording. A verbatim-wording counterfactual reaches only source_grounded_extra_object. The residual question — whether S1 payment structure should exist as a golden claim or only cross-family as term_dry_run_002 — is a golden-policy judgment, not an isolable evaluator defect.

Same structural situation as claim_payment_term_1 and coupled to it: both decompose the identical S1 span, and both are additionally coupled to deliverable_1 through source_claim_ids. Diagnosing one in isolation would either understate the coupling or require batching multiple criticals, which this PR forbids.

The golden deliverable_assessments family is empty, so no same-family comparison exists at all. Its grounding predicate depends transitively on claim alignment, so its severity is a cascade of the claim criticals rather than an independent condition. Restricting source_claim_ids to the only matched claim still leaves it critical. Highest risk of drawing a false conclusion.

runtime_change_gate.reason: The evidence proves the evaluator defect but does not determine the correct replacement tier. The generic evaluator path would yield major granularity_split, while PR #26 established minor agreement_term_decomposition for the structurally analogous consolidated-golden case in the agreement_terms family. Those two live precedents conflict for this object, and choosing between them is a policy decision this PR has not evidenced. Correcting now would silently resolve that conflict.
runtime_change_gate.recommended_next_action: A narrowly scoped PR #28 should decide the claims-family tier for a faithful decomposition of a compound matched golden claim, then bind it fail-closed to the frozen fingerprints recorded here, preserving the unmatched object and proving that only this one finding entry changes.
